composition_subtypes.role: Tracks minimum last element for each XOR value
Efficiently schedules transitions via range list updates

payload.core_composition_summary: DP with 1D state over XOR values, optimized with amortized range update lists to achieve O(N + maxVal^2) complexity.
payload.rationale: Uses dp_1d_state to store min ending value per XOR. Amortized list updates, akin to amortized_two_pointers, efficiently process transitions without iterating all previous values.
